title: Study to Test Effects and Safety of RO7568282 in Participants With Early Symptomatic Alzheimer’s Disease
official: A PHASE II, RANDOMIZED, DOUBLE-BLIND, PLACEBO-CONTROLLED, MULTICENTER  STUDY TO EVALUATE THE EFFICACY,  SAFETY, AND PHARMACOKINETICS OF  RO7568282 IN PARTICIPANTS WITH EARLY SYMPTOMATIC ALZHEIMER’S DISEASE
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effect of RO7568282 on clinical progression at Week 72 compared with placebo with respect to change from baseline to Week 72 in Clinical Dementia Rating, Sum of Boxes (CDR-SB)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Evidence of AD pathological process, as confirmed by amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) scan or CSF
2. Mild cognitive impairment (MCI) or mild dementia due to Alzheimer’s Disease (AD)
3. Able to swallow whole capsules
4. Body mass index within the range of 18-34 kg/m² (at Screening)
5. Availability of an appropriate study partner
Exclusion criteria:
1. Any evidence of a condition other than AD that may affect cognition
2. Participants must not have unstable or clinically significant cardiovascular disease within the last year, chronic uncontrolled hypertension, or clinically significant ECG abnormalities
3. History or presence of clinically significant cerebrovascular disease
4. Clinically significant cerebral abnormalities on MRI
